title: Footer Colophon
description: The dark bar under the footer photograph — live's `footer#colophon.content-info`: the copyright line on the left, the Privacy Policy / Terms & Conditions pair on the right. Measured on live 2026-08-20: `#41382E` ground (`primary-600` is `#403028`, a distance of 10 in sRGB) and 15px of vertical padding (`spacing.20` is 14–20px). ⚠️ **The text colour is deliberately NOT live's.** Live sets both the credit and the terms links to `#847C73` on `#41382E`, which measures **2.54:1** — a WCAG AA failure on 15px type, which needs 4.5:1. `neutral-400` measures **6.33:1** on this ground and passes AA and AAA. It is also the resting half of a pair live already implies: live's terms-link hover is `#DCD6C9`, which is `neutral-300` to within a distance of 4, and that is kept exactly. The alternative, `neutral-500`, was rejected at 3.95:1 — closer to live's tone but still failing AA for body text. Recorded in style.md as an accessibility correction, not a design change; the gesture (muted warm grey on brown, brightening on hover) is live's.
